value.message: Manage model versions across your instance and skills.
Each model type has a default version selected by ServiceNow. You can update the target model version by making a selection.
Below are the default ServiceNow configurations for certain model versions. To change or override them, select “Update model version” and create a new configuration.
This configuration is disabled since a custom configuration has been applied by you.
Updating the model version at skill level replaces the existing instance-level model version selected for each provider. This action should be performed in exceptional circumstances only.
Choose the skills you wish to refresh the model version for.
Ask Now Assist for help or search

LLMs are large, versatile AI models trained on broad datasets, offering strong reasoning but needing significant resources. SLMs are smaller, efficient, and designed for specific tasks, making them quicker and cheaper to use in specialized or resource-limited settings.
What is the difference between SLM and LLM?

A default model is the original language model, whereas a target model is the language model or SLM that is adapted for a particular application or service. This distinction applies in settings involving LLMs or SLMs, where the creator of the model (default) is not the same as the organization deploying it to users (target)
What is the difference between default and target model provider?

Choose an appropriate model version by considering project objectives and technical specifications. Define the intended use case and assess relevant factors to determine which model aligns best with the your requirements.
